purpose: Prospective combined SC/SFP simulation-only last-inch study after recovery and speed development

development_stages.historical_replay: 17 fixed original cases, restored V38 code and new recovery20261112 checkpoints; no tuning during replay
development_stages.speed_screen: 6 matched cases (3 SC, 3 SFP), speed43 candidate against recovered baseline; original outcomes retained
development_stages.selection: Candidate needs all 6 independent geometric/contact/force verifications and at least 10 percent lower median simulated action time for each connector on matched cases. Otherwise retain baseline or fix on development cases and requalify. No final case may guide selection.

readiness: Complete and inspect both development stages; investigate setup and policy failures without removing them
Freeze chosen source, original/adapted weight hashes, physics plugin, public asset revision and all measurement profiles
Verify contact-positive-control contract and calibrated setup including all six cameras
Run current-method negative controls and freeze ablation implementations before opening final cases

sc.allocation: 10 cases per SC mount, randomized fixed order
sc.grasp_jitter: 25 selected independently before execution, +/-2mm translation and existing source-grasp rotation jitter; upstream tip angular alignment is still prescribed

sfp.allocation: 5 cases per slot across five NICs and both slots, randomized fixed order
sfp.grasp_profile: legacy_sfp with existing seeded unknown-grasp jitter
sfp.fixture_condition: Public level fixture family; no unrestricted six-DOF claim

simulator_ground_truth: Setup and independent scoring only; production policy uses RGB, exposure-time own-robot transforms, own kinematics and wrist force

force.interpretation: Post-hoc measured ceiling, not a guaranteed bound from a lower-rate controller guard

scoring: Unchanged SC/SFP depth, lateral, full-angle, continuous terminal dwell and physical contact/clearance-control gates; whole-trial observed penetration and complete raw-force audit
record: All-selected and policy-eligible success counts with Wilson 95 percent intervals
Successful action simulation and wall times, plus elapsed time for every failure
Raw peak, p95, over-limit counts and force sampling completeness
Terminal depth, lateral/angle errors, observed penetration and contact evidence
Target/slot, gap, translation, angular and grasp-jitter configuration
Setup, perception, contact observability, alignment, force, timeout and verification failure causes
Headless before/during/after camera images, raw traces, source and weight checksums

ablation_extension.paired_subset: 20 cases per connector selected before execution, two matched ablations each; full-policy outcomes come from the same 100 primary trials
conditions: Discard measured axial correction while retaining the same contact motions and checks
Disable lateral tracking compensation while retaining perception and measurement checks
ablation_extension.implementation_status: Pending implementation and development qualification; no ablation results claimed
ablation_extension.statistics: Paired outcome differences and exact McNemar tests with multiplicity correction; separate timings and forces

storage: Stop at a safe trial boundary below 8 GiB free; preserve exported raw traces, checkpoint objects and selected camera evidence
publication_scope: Simulation-only conditional held-grasp last-inch insertion for both connector types; no pickup, general rotation, latch retention, electrical mating or hardware validation claim
